title: Dynamic Sampling that Adapts: Self-Aware Iterative Data Persistent Optimization for Mathematical Reasoning
authors_zh: Jun Rao, Xuebo Liu, Hexuan Deng, Zepeng Lin, Zixiong Yu, Jiansheng Wei, Xiaojun Meng, Min Zhang
paper_type_zh: 用于离线偏好优化的动态数学推理数据选择
best_for_zh: 为迭代数学推理训练构建学习者自适应偏好数据集的读者。
one_line: SAI-DPO repeatedly selects preference-training records using model-relative knowledge weaknesses and self-aware difficulty.
SAI-DPO 按模型相对的知识弱点和自感知难度反复选择偏好训练记录。
why: It turns changing learner competence into an explicit policy for which preference pairs enter the next optimization round.
inclusion_reason: It reconstructs which prompts and generated preference pairs are consumed by iterative post-training from the learner’s current weaknesses and difficulty frontier.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Mathematical-reasoning post-training often fixes a dataset or relies on a teacher-defined difficulty score. Both decisions can become stale as the learner changes: an item that initially provides useful challenge can later be trivial, while an item that is difficult to a teacher or a human may be irrelevant or unlearnable for the current student. Continuing to optimize on either extreme wastes preference-training samples.

This work asks how the current model can determine which mathematical prompts and generated answer pairs should form its next offline preference-optimization set. The intervention is data acquisition during iterative training, not merely a different DPO loss. The authors seek a mixture aligned with the model's weak knowledge areas and its present difficulty frontier, so that the records used for the next update remain useful as competence evolves.

数学推理的后训练常固定使用一个数据集，或依赖教师定义的难度分数。随着学习者改变，这两种决策都可能过时：最初带来有效挑战的题目后来会变得简单，而对教师或人类困难的题目对当前学生可能无关或不可学。在任一极端上继续优化都会浪费偏好训练样本。

本文追问当前模型怎样决定哪些数学提示及其生成回答对应该构成下一轮离线偏好优化集合。干预点是迭代训练期间的数据获取，而不只是换一种 DPO 损失。作者希望得到一个同时对齐模型薄弱知识区域和当前难度前沿的混合，使下一次更新所用记录会随能力变化而持续有用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SAI-DPO treats high-quality training data as learner-relative and time-varying. It maps prompts into semantic knowledge clusters, finds clusters overrepresented among the model's mistakes, and measures each prompt's self-aware difficulty from the model's pass rate together with reasoning-path step count and length. The resulting sampler is meant to focus on weaknesses without equating every hard question with a useful one.

For a selected prompt, multiple model rollouts provide correct and incorrect solutions. One correct solution becomes the preferred answer and one incorrect solution becomes the rejected answer for an offline DPO triple. The selection first removes prompts the current model always solves or never solves, then keeps the more challenging portion of the remaining distribution. After DPO changes the model, the same measurements are recalibrated, so the definition of a useful record changes with the learner.

SAI-DPO 将高质量训练数据视为与学习者相关且随时间变化的对象。它把提示映射到语义知识簇，找出在模型错误中占比过高的簇，并根据模型通过率以及推理路径的步骤数和长度度量每个提示的自感知难度。由此得到的采样器旨在聚焦薄弱处，而不把每道难题都等同于有用题目。

对被选中的提示，多次模型展开会产生正确和错误解答。一条正确解答成为偏好回答，一条错误解答成为拒绝回答，从而构成离线 DPO 三元组。选择先去掉当前模型总能解出或从未解出的提示，再保留其余分布中较具挑战的部分。DPO 改变模型后，相同度量会被重新校准，因此有用记录的定义会随学习者变化。

title: Method
方法
html:
At each iteration, the current model labels the pool through repeated responses and a correctness check, producing a pass rate for each question. A sentence-transformer embedding and clustering stage assign knowledge semantics, while the error dataset reveals clusters where the learner is weak. Self-aware difficulty combines the pass rate with path complexity indicators: number of reasoning steps and answer length resolve cases with comparable pass rates. The paper uses eight rollouts for exploration and filters out all-correct and all-wrong examples.

The main offline-RL study starts from 400K Numina-Math prompts. It samples 20K prompts per iteration for eight iterations, generates preference pairs, and retains the top 70% of remaining examples after the extreme filter; the reported Qwen2.5-7B-Math-Base run consumes 48K training samples in total. It compares with iterative DPO using random samples, PPO, hard mining, curriculum, clustering-only selection, and external difficulty. It also applies the selected data to rejection-sampling fine-tuning, separating the data policy from one particular optimizer.

在每一轮中，当前模型通过重复回答和正确性检查为候选池打标，为每个问题产生通过率。句子转换器嵌入和聚类阶段分配知识语义，错误数据集则暴露学习者薄弱的簇。自感知难度把通过率与路径复杂度指标结合：推理步骤数和回答长度用于区分通过率相近的情况。论文使用八次展开进行探索，并过滤掉全对和全错的例子。

主要离线强化学习研究从 400K 条 Numina-Math 提示开始。它进行八轮，每轮抽取 20K 条提示、生成偏好对，并在极端过滤后保留剩余例子的前 70%；报告的 Qwen2.5-7B-Math-Base 运行总共消费 48K 条训练样本。比较对象包括使用随机样本的迭代 DPO、PPO、困难样本挖掘、课程学习、仅聚类选择和外部难度。它还将所选数据用于拒绝采样微调，从而把数据策略与某一种优化器分开。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Qwen2.5-7B-Math-Base, SAI-DPO reports a 53.7 average over eight math benchmarks, compared with 52.0 for iterative DPO; its AIME24 score is 23.7 versus 19.4 and AMC23 is 63.3 versus 60.4. On Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, the average is 28.7 versus 26.9, and on Qwen3-8B it is 59.2 versus 58.4. The strongest improvements are concentrated on more difficult competition-style tests rather than saturated GSM8K results.

The efficiency table compares 48K selected offline-RL records with 67K for iterative DPO and 400K samples for PPO, yielding 53.7 versus 52.0 and 54.6 respectively for the specified Qwen base model. Ablating semantic alignment reduces the average by 2.3 points, removing self-aware difficulty by 1.2, and removing pass rate by 1.6. The paper also finds that an externally defined difficulty schedule underperforms the internal measurement, with a 49.9 average versus 53.7, and that the selected subset can improve rejection-sampling SFT by three average points.

在 Qwen2.5-7B-Math-Base 上，SAI-DPO 报告八个数学基准的平均分为 53.7，而迭代 DPO 为 52.0；其 AIME24 为 23.7 对 19.4，AMC23 为 63.3 对 60.4。在 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 上，平均为 28.7 对 26.9，在 Qwen3-8B 上为 59.2 对 58.4。最强提升集中在更难的竞赛型测试，而非已趋饱和的 GSM8K 结果。

效率表对指定的 Qwen 基础模型比较了 48K 条所选离线强化学习记录、67K 条迭代 DPO 记录和 400K 条 PPO 样本，得到的平均分分别为 53.7、52.0 和 54.6。去掉语义对齐会使平均下降 2.3 分，去掉自感知难度下降 1.2 分，去掉通过率下降 1.6 分。论文还发现外部定义的难度日程不如内部度量，平均为 49.9 对 53.7，而且所选子集可使拒绝采样监督微调提高三分平均值。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior dynamic reasoning training can iterate model updates, but it need not make the training mixture explicitly dependent on a measured map of the learner's knowledge weaknesses and current solvability. SAI-DPO makes the data record's eligibility conditional on both. It distinguishes a prompt that is genuinely informative for this model from one merely assigned a high external difficulty label.

The contribution is not to claim that all hard examples should be oversampled. Its filter removes both solved and unsolved extremes before ranking the remaining prompts, while semantic clustering supplies a second axis for coverage of weak areas. This combines an error-conditioned knowledge distribution with a learner-conditioned difficulty estimate and turns the combination into concrete preference pairs for DPO. The resulting object is a changing training dataset, not just a post-hoc analysis of benchmark errors.

先前的动态推理训练可以迭代模型更新，却不一定让训练混合显式依赖于对学习者知识弱点和当前可解性的测量。SAI-DPO 让数据记录的准入同时取决于二者。它区分了对这个模型真正有信息量的提示，和仅被赋予较高外部难度标签的提示。

其贡献并非主张应过采样所有困难例子。它先移除已解和不可解两个极端，再对剩余提示排序，而语义聚类提供薄弱领域覆盖的第二个轴。它把由错误驱动的知识分布与由学习者驱动的难度估计结合，并将这一组合转化为用于 DPO 的具体偏好对。由此得到的是一个不断变化的训练数据集，而非对基准错误的事后分析。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors evaluate sampling only with offline methods such as iterative DPO and do not test the policy on mainstream online methods such as PPO; their final offline score also remains below the PPO result in the efficiency table. Experiments are limited to mathematical reasoning, so transfer to code or general instruction tasks is unknown. The approach depends on generated correctness labels, semantic clustering, and repeated rollouts, each of which can introduce cost or error; it also benefits from a stronger knowledge-tag annotator. No official implementation or newly released dataset is linked by the paper, so exact reproduction requires reconstructing the pipeline and verifying the upstream data and evaluation settings.
作者只用迭代 DPO 等离线方法评估采样，未在 PPO 等主流在线方法上测试该策略；效率表中最终的离线分数也仍低于 PPO 结果。实验限于数学推理，故能否迁移到代码或通用指令任务尚不清楚。该方法依赖生成的正确性标签、语义聚类和重复展开，它们都会带来成本或误差；它也会受益于更强的知识标签标注器。论文没有链接官方实现或新发布数据集，因此精确复现需要重建流程，并核验上游数据和评测设置。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this study when constructing iterative preference data for a reasoning learner whose weaknesses can be measured repeatedly. Record the candidate-pool version, correctness verifier, rollout count and decoding settings, embedding model and clustering parameters, error-cluster statistics, pass-rate and path-complexity formulas, extreme filtering rule, selected prompt IDs, and preferred/rejected solutions. Compare against random and fixed-difficulty selection with equal numbers of prompts and iterations. The paper is especially useful for avoiding the common shortcut of treating teacher-defined difficulty as the learner's difficulty; however, its resource claims and mathematics-only scope should not be extrapolated to online RL or other domains without new experiments.

当为可重复测量弱点的推理学习者构建迭代偏好数据时，可使用此研究。应记录候选池版本、正确性验证器、展开次数和解码设置、嵌入模型与聚类参数、错误簇统计、通过率和路径复杂度公式、极端过滤规则、所选提示标识以及偏好与拒绝解答。应在相同提示数和轮数下与随机和固定难度选择比较。该论文尤其有助于避免把教师定义的难度当作学习者难度这一常见捷径；但在没有新实验时，不应将其资源声明和仅数学的范围外推到在线强化学习或其他领域。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The central distinction is between an external label of difficulty and a student-relative estimate of trainability. SAI-DPO needs both a knowledge dimension—where the learner fails—and a difficulty dimension—whether the learner can productively improve on a particular prompt now. Its preference triples are produced after this decision, so the work belongs with training-data usage rather than with a standalone DPO algorithm. When reading the results, distinguish the gain over the random iterative baseline from the remaining gap to PPO, and inspect whether the cost of repeated rollouts and annotation is acceptable for the intended setting.
核心区别在于外部难度标签与学生相对的可训练性估计。SAI-DPO 同时需要知识维度——学习者在哪里失败——和难度维度——学习者现在能否从某一提示中有效进步。其偏好三元组是在这一决策之后产生的，因此该工作属于训练数据使用，而不是独立的 DPO 算法。阅读结果时，应区分相对随机迭代基线的收益与相对 PPO 的剩余差距，并检查重复展开和标注的成本是否可被目标场景接受。
